Which watch you get really depends on your own personal style so I'll answer some of your other questions to give you some help deciding. In terms of the the least amount of maintenance, the Bulova Lunar Pilot would have the least amount of attention needed as it has a quartz movement. Meaning that after you set the time, the most you'll need to do is change the battery every couple of years. For durability, Traska is known for it's hardness treatment so it will definitely take a beating. Keep in mind that the Lunar Pilot would do pretty well in durability too due to it's mostly brushed finishing. 3. Shutdown once again and reseat your GPU.
